title: Step timers not stored survive an abort and change the step state afterwards
description:
indigo_sequencer_next_ok_handler() sets the step to Ok and runs execute_next() without checking that a sequence runs, and abort() cancels only wait_for_timer while most next_ok timers are not stored in it. An abort or failed flip inside such a window can turn the step state Alert back to Ok while SEQUENCE_STATE stays Alert. A late timer after a new start() might also advance that sequence, this was not traced. Pre-existing, found by code inspection, not reproduced. Next: return from the handler when no sequence runs, or store the timers, with a test that aborts inside the 0.5 s window after a mount process.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261103084208-ca1a-sequence-state-outside-sequence-001.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
